message:
mwan3: return zero for empty integer state

An empty mwan3track state file becomes NaN in the rpcd response. Default
failed integer conversions to zero, as the shell handler did.

Add a focused regression for the installed integer helpers to test.sh
and bump the package release.

Fixes: #29653
Signed-off-by: Yuen Su <zypulsecore@gmail.com>

mwan3: normalize expanded nexthop routes before copying

The kernel's nexthop compatibility dump contains both nhid and its
expanded via/dev fields. Replaying both makes iproute2 reject the route.
Remove the redundant ID from expanded routes, keeping ID-only routes
and other attributes intact.

Cover the parser cases in the existing package test.sh and bump the
package release.

Fixes: #27066
Signed-off-by: Yuen Su <zypulsecore@gmail.com>

mwan3: select delegated IPv6 sources by their full prefix

The textual prefix fallback can truncate addresses containing 7-9 and
select an address outside the delegated network. Use ip's existing CIDR
filter to select an assigned global address within the delegated prefix.
Preserve direct netifd addresses and existing non-PD fallbacks.

Add regression cases to test.sh and bump the package release.

Fixes: 75a96faba764 ("mwan3: common.sh: fix src_ip detection for ipv6-PD")
Signed-off-by: Yuen Su <zypulsecore@gmail.com>
